svg.title: Geohash cells around a rider near the edge of cell tdr1v
svg.desc: A 3 by 3 grid of length-5 geohash cells in Bengaluru, each about 4.9 km across. The rider is 0.4 km below the top edge of tdr1v. Driver A is inside tdr1v but about 3.5 km away; driver B is in tdr4j, the cell to the north, about 1 km away. Searching only the prefix tdr1v finds A; searching the cell and its 8 neighbours finds B.
